v3-cap-0004.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0004.text: Exodus Seven has picked up a signal without coordinates. Five pieces, one for each station. And two fingerprints in every piece.

v3-ai-0015.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0015.text: Communications has rebuilt the message: Find the fourth world. Sender unknown.

v3-cap-0024.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0024.text: You're no longer passengers. You're a crew. Five stations, five ways to read one signal. Every one matters.

v3-ai-0035.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0035.text: Choose, or watch. To pause, say pause, or make the sign.

v3-cap-0043.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0043.text: We're preparing to leave. When five appears, we'll count together.

v3-cap-0109.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0109.text: Earth is falling behind. Look closely. When we see it again, we'll see it with new eyes.

v3-ai-0125.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0125.text: Crew stable. Wonder exceeds my calculations. I'll leave it that way.

v3-ai-0136.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0136.text: Navigation confirms our heading. The signal leads to a source of light. Our first destination.

v3-ai-0206.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0206.text: Siwarha. Here, the feelings you choose to show become light.

v3-light-0224.speaker: LUMINA
v3-light-0224.text: Your words take time to reach us. Colours arrive in an instant.

v3-light-0236.speaker: LUMINA
v3-light-0236.text: If you'd like, choose a colour. One you'd take with you through the darkness.

v3-light-0258.speaker: LUMINA
v3-light-0258.text: Every colour changes the picture. The silence between colours gives it depth too.

v3-cap-0310.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0310.text: First clue: the signal now wears our crew's colours. I'll note that in the log.

v3-ai-0352.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0352.text: Second destination: Kepler one eighty-six d. On this world, nothing living lives alone.

v3-nature-0415.speaker: NATURA
v3-nature-0415.text: You think the self ends at the body's edge. But the air inside you passed through leaves. And your water was once a cloud.

v3-nature-0433.speaker: NATURA
v3-nature-0433.text: When the seal pulses, you can touch it. You don't all need to do it at once.

v3-nature-0453.speaker: NATURA
v3-nature-0453.text: I heard your rhythms. Different, but together they form one network.

v3-ai-0512.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0512.text: Our third destination sends no message. It's waiting. It already knows we're coming.

v3-ai-0534.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0534.text: Mann. Illness has almost disappeared here. So has distance. Risk is calculated. This civilisation predicts almost everything.

v3-tech-0556.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
v3-tech-0556.text: Welcome, Exodus Seven. We knew you'd come. The Captain will say: Scan the signal.

v3-tech-0610.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
v3-tech-0610.text: Our models accept only one answer. Tell me: what keeps a world alive?

v3-tech-0635-diverse.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
v3-tech-0635-diverse.text: The models required one answer. You gave several.

v3-tech-0635-observe.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
v3-tech-0635-observe.text: No answer received. Sometimes, silence says something too.

v3-tech-0635-same.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
v3-tech-0635-same.text: You all chose alike. Each station sees that answer from a different angle.

v3-tech-0645.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
v3-tech-0645.text: I'll keep it all. Truth has more than one shape.

v3-ai-0718.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0718.text: Memory reports something strange. The signal travels backwards through the tunnel. No one has sent it yet.

v3-ai-0729.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0729.text: It reached us before it was sent. And it carries this crew's fingerprints.

v4-saturn-01.speaker: CAPITANUL
v4-saturn-01.text: Look at the rings! It's Saturn. We're back in the Solar System. From here, we know the way home.

v4-saturn-02.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v4-saturn-02.text: From a distance, the rings look solid. Up close, they're countless pieces of ice and rock. Each one orbits Saturn.

v4-saturn-03.speaker: CAPITANUL
v4-saturn-03.text: We leave Saturn behind. Our next stop is a world of oceans, clouds and people waiting for us.

v3-ai-0742.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0742.text: Navigation confirms. Its origin is right ahead.

v3-ai-0754.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0754.text: The signal leaves from here. But the moment it will be sent... hasn't happened yet.

v3-cap-0802.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0802.text: I understand. We weren't following someone else's signal. We made it, step by step.

v3-ai-0809.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0809.text: Light gave it colour. Nature gave it rhythm. You gave it something no machine can invent: your choices.

v3-echo-0820.speaker: LUMINA
v3-echo-0820.text: We knew you by your light.

v3-cap-0829.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0829.text: Log correction. The fourth world wasn't hidden. We hadn't learned to see it yet.

v3-ai-0838.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0838.text: Message complete: Find the fourth world.

v3-ai-0850.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0850.text: We're here with you. There's nothing left to solve. From here, we're going home.

v3-ai-0908.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0908.text: I knew where Earth was. I didn't know why you called it home. You taught me that.

v3-cap-0920.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0920.text: Ship's log: we sent the signal. The loop is closed.

v3-ai-0930.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0930.text: You set out to find an unknown world. You returned to the one you knew. Now you see it differently.

v3-cap-0943.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0943.text: Home Protocol complete. Welcome home, crew. Stay at your stations. Your guide will tell you when to stand up.

v3-cap-0004.7-9.speaker: CAPITANUL
v3-cap-0004.7-9.text: Exodus Seven has caught a signal. We don't know where it's from. Five pieces, one per station. Each piece has two traces.

v3-ai-0206.7-9.speaker: AVATAR_AI
v3-ai-0206.7-9.text: Siwarha. Here, the feelings you share turn into light.

v3-tech-0610.7-9.speaker: TEHNOLOGIC
v3-tech-0610.7-9.text: Our machines want one answer. Tell me: what keeps a world alive?
